thread:
oliver (sec): FYI found a Vault token ciphertext (KMS-wrapped) leaked in a debug log from the metrics aggregator last night. Not sure if ciphertext itself was exfil but we must treat it as exposed. File: gs://metrics-agg-logs/2026-03-22/agg-7.log.gz. Need containment + rotation plan.

rebecca (oncall): oncall ack. Can you paste the log snippet?

oliver (sec): snippet: `metrics/agg: auth: wrapped_token=gcp-kms:v2:CT:BB23...` discovered by diff alert.

mike (infra): If it's a wrapped ciphertext the immediate risk depends on access to the wrapping key and its IAM bindings. I'll enumerate key bindings and SA keys. Running `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy telemetry-key --keyring=telemetry --location=us-central1` now.

sophie (platform): We should rotate the SA keys that have decrypt rights and rotate the KMS key (create new primary version). Also plan to rewrap any ciphertext objects we control.

ashley (eng): The aggregator service used a long-lived Vault token fetched at startup. We must ensure pods request short-lived tokens and avoid logging raw token material. I'll update the Helm chart to use Vault Agent with auth method and set token_ttl=15m.

rebecca (oncall): I'm revoking the exposed Vault token now (have token id) and will disable the SA key associated with the aggregator service account. Posting statuses.

audit-bot: action logged  rotate-sa-key aggregator-sa (job-id: 5088)

oliver (sec): Compliance note: do NOT delete original logs. Copy originals to gs://sec-archive/INC-2026-072/raw/ then create a redacted copy for ops at gs://sec-archive/INC-2026-072/redacted/. Claire, please confirm retention window.

claire (compliance): Confirmed. We'll snapshot originals and set retention. Tag all objects with incident=INC-2026-072.

mike (infra): Rewrap plan: - snapshot ciphertexts in secrets bucket - run controlled decrypt using old key (only on a locked worker with limited network) - encrypt with new primary key -> write back. I'll run a canary against a small prefix first. Pseudo: `gcloud kms decrypt --ciphertext-file=- --location=us-central1 --keyring=telemetry --key=key-old | gcloud kms encrypt --location=us-central1 --keyring=telemetry --key=key-new` and atomically replace objects.

ashley (eng): Also found one external partner sent a copy of a token in a webhook payload we receive. I've opened PARTNER-802 and asked them to rotate anything they mirrored.

oliver (sec): Additional controls: - remove roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter from aggregator-sa - enable Workload Identity so the pod impersonates a short-lived GCP identity - add regex-based blocker in our logging pipeline to redact token-like strings before writing logs.

rebecca (oncall): Rotation progress: aggregator SA key rotated -> new key id sa-agg-20260322-2. Vault token revoked id `s.exposedtokid`. Aggregator pods restarted with new creds. Still todo: KMS rewrap + log redaction.

deploy-bot: scheduled rotate-and-rewrap job for 2026-03-23T03:30:00Z (job-9901)

mike (infra): I'll run the rewrap during that window. Will also produce a verification script to attempt decrypt with new key and perform smoke tests.

ashley (eng): Helm change pushed to feature branch: use Vault Agent + short-lived tokens, and add `LOG_REDACT_PATTERNS` env var to aggregator. Will request PR review.

oliver (sec): Post-incident checklist owners: infra (mike) for rewrap/keys, eng (ashley) for code/runbook changes, sec (oliver) for audit and postmortem, compliance (claire) for log retention. Create INC-2026-072 and add timeline.

claire (compliance): Please attach all exported audit logs (KMS activity, Vault audit) to the incident bucket. We'll keep them immutable for 90 days.

rebecca (oncall): All immediate containment done. Reopen here if rewrap or partner actions reveal anything else.

oliver (sec): Thanks team. Adding a follow-up: add a pre-commit linter to block commits that introduce high-verbosity logging with string interpolation of `token`, `wrap`, `cipher`, `vault`.

mike (infra): Noted. I'll also add a CI check that scans new log lines in staging for token-like regexes.

oliver (sec): Closing initial coordination thread. :lock:
